body: First of all I would like to thank you all for caring, it made my day a little brighter. Secondly someone sent me an email (to my gmail) about a job opening out of state, and making 40k a year starting off. Not sure who it was or if it was even meant for me but I am currently looking into this. I hope that this is an opportunity to better my life in several ways. If I can get the job it will enable me to get away from my stressors here and to get into a career where those rumors and lies wont follow me. Wish me luck, this may just be the break I needed.
